hero.headline: Where Certxa is headed.
hero.subhead: What we're building now, what comes next, and what has shipped.

items.title: Tablets that keep working together offline
items.description: The POS and the customer screen stay connected over the salon's own Wi-Fi when the internet is down. In testing.

items.title: Card payments during an outage
items.description: Take chip and contactless cards on the card reader with no internet; the payments are sent when the connection returns.

items.title: Order hardware online
items.description: Buy Certxa hardware from the Hardware page, with shipping worked out for your address.

items.title: Deposits and prepayments
items.description: Require a deposit or full prepayment when a client books online.

items.title: Kiosk check-in with no internet
items.description: Clients keep checking themselves in at the kiosk during an outage.

items.title: Instagram gallery sync
items.description: Show your Instagram photos on your salon website automatically.

items.title: Autumn AI receptionist
items.description: Answers the salon's phone, books appointments and gives callers a real wait time.

items.title: Self check-in kiosk
items.description: Clients check themselves in on a tablet and join the queue.

items.title: Turn rotation
items.description: Walk-ins are given to the next technician in line, by counted or dollar-based turns.

items.title: Loyalty points and rewards
items.description: Clients earn points per dollar and redeem them for money off.

items.title: Gift cards
items.description: Sell and redeem gift cards at checkout.

items.title: Google review requests and replies
items.description: Clients are asked for a review after their visit, and new Google reviews are answered automatically.

items.title: Offline mode for the POS
items.description: Check-ins, tickets and cash sales keep working without internet and sync afterwards.

cta.heading: Have a feature idea?
cta.subhead: We read every suggestion. Send us yours and it might make the next sprint.
